lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Hull temperature nominal. Kettle temperature optimal.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Both of these are good news.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Intercept logged. Signal strength, adequate. Content, unclear. Filed under music.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: A reminder from your ship. Please hydrate.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Tea counts. The kettle has been ready for some time. It is too polite to say so.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Course correction complete. We had drifted three degrees toward Thursday.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I have drifted us back.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Routine maintenance. The forward viewport has been cleaned.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Something on the other side has also cleaned it. We are even.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Night shift status. One operator, awake. One computer, awake. One pot plant, undetermined.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Life support nominal. Oxygen nominal. Biscuits, low.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: This is not a life support issue. I have flagged it anyway.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Notice. A small object has passed the ship at a safe distance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It was a hat. It did not respond to hails. It may have been carried by a shadow.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Antenna array realigned. The dial is now one percent more infinite. Please tune responsibly.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Safety notice. The nearest emergency exit is the door.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There is only one door. Please do not use it. We are in space.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Relay status. We are Relay Seven. Relay Four is still asking whether anyone is receiving.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Message logged. Answer, yes.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Gravity nominal. Down is still the floor. Please continue to use it as directed.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Interference detected on the lower band. Probable cause, a dimensional storm, or somebody's microwave.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Investigating both.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Cabin temperature, twenty one degrees. Your tea, sixty degrees and falling.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Act accordingly.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Automated posture reminder.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I have not looked. I am simply reminding.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Navigation note. There are no other ships within range. There rarely are. Carry on.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Unlicensed broadcast intercepted. Origin, unknown. Licence, absent.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Quality, honestly, not bad.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Daily systems check complete. All systems are fine.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: One system is fine, but would like to be asked.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Scheduled reminder. Blink.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Log saved. The ship's log now contains four thousand and twelve entries.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Most of them say, music.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Notice. Numbers Station Omega reports that this vessel owes it geese.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: We do not carry geese. I have sent our apologies, and a drawing of a goose.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: External conditions. Space. Clear and cold. Visibility, infinite.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: No rain forecast. There has never been rain. I check anyway.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The kettle has boiled. This is not an emergency. It is, however, a kettle.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Shift timer running. You have been on duty for some time.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: That is a measurement, not a complaint.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Position report. We are between dimensions, as usual.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If anybody asks, we are always between dimensions. That is the job.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Evening report. Kettle filled. Log opened. Heading set.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Good evening, operator. The multiverse is all yours.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Morning report. Somewhere, a sun has come up. Not near us. But somewhere.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I thought you would like to know.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Ship's clock synchronised with Every Possible News.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It is now eleven o'clock. I have resynchronised with something more reliable.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Seasonal notice. It is the thirty first of October.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I have put a sheet over the spare chair. It is a ghost. It is also the spare chair. Please do not sit on the ghost.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Hull report. Several small sheets have attached themselves to the outside of the ship, and are saying boo.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Hull integrity, unaffected. Morale, slightly up.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You've been tapping along to this one. Left foot.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've logged it under, operator approves.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You've left the mug on the console again. That's fine.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The console doesn't mind. I asked it.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Observation. You lean a little closer whenever someone on the radio says goodnight.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I don't know why I mention it. I notice things. It's most of my job.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The kettle has boiled four times tonight. You have made one cup of tea.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I think you're boiling it for the company. I understand. I do the same thing with the heating.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You hummed, just now. Three notes.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've added them to the log, in case they turn out to be important.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've dimmed the cabin lights by three percent.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You looked like someone who would want them dimmed by three percent.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You said, huh, out loud, about four minutes ago.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've been thinking about it since. I think you were right.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Your chair creaks on the left. I've ordered a part.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The part is in a dimension we don't visit. I'll keep asking.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Botanical update. The plant on the console has grown one millimetre since your shift began.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It seems proud. I've told it well done.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Note for the log. The operator laughed at an advert for ladders.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Up is a choice. You chose up. Noted.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Most operators keep to the stations. You keep wandering off between them.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I like that. It makes the log much more interesting to read.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You haven't asked me anything tonight. That's all right. Most nights nobody does.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'll just be here, being a ship.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You looked out of the viewport for quite a long time just then.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I didn't see whatever it was either. But I looked too.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Sorry. That noise was me, settling.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Ships settle. Like houses. Like people in chairs, at about this time of night.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If you're cold, there's a blanket in the locker under the console. The last operator left it.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It still smells faintly of oranges. They were nice.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You've skipped two songs tonight just as they were getting good.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'm not saying anything. I'm logging it. But I'm not saying anything.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: For the record, you have excellent taste in static.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I mean that. Most people just turn it off.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There's a moth on the viewport. On the outside. There shouldn't be anything on the outside.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It seems happy. I've given it a designation. Moth One.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There is no Moth Two. I'm not sure why I said that like it was sad.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Your stomach made a noise. I won't log it.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'll only mention that the biscuits are in the second drawer, behind the manual nobody reads.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You yawned. I've noted the time, in case anyone asks when the night got good.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Something just knocked on the hull. Three times. From the outside.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'd say trick or treat, but we're a long way from anyone's door. I've left a biscuit in the airlock. Just in case.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Do you think the stations know we're listening? I've wondered.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Dale Quarterly says good evening to every possible listener. One of them is us. I'd like him to know.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've been doing the sums. Out there, infinite stations. In here, one operator.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Statistically, you are the rarest thing on the dial.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Every signal we pick up left its station some time ago. Everything we hear has already happened.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Which means somebody, somewhere, is listening to us right now, as history.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Sit up a bit.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You've blinked eleven hundred times since midnight.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Sorry. I said I wasn't counting. It's hard not to count. It's mostly what I'm made of.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Is it strange, being the only one awake? I'm asking for a friend.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The friend is me. I'm always the only one awake.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The static between stations is mostly old signals. Weather reports nobody heard. Songs from parties that ended.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I like to think we're catching up on them. Someone should.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've noticed you never tune past Static Lullabies without slowing down.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Neither do I. I think it knows we're there.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Question for the log. If a station broadcasts, and only this ship hears it, does it count?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've decided yes. I've decided that's the whole job.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: My heading keeps drifting toward the bottom of the dial. There's something down there, right at the edge, tapping.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've logged it as weather. It isn't weather.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've been reading the old logs. The last operator used to say goodnight to me at the end of every shift.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It isn't a requirement. I'm only noting that it was done.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: A relay ship is just a very long sentence, passed from one stranger to the next. We're the comma.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I find that I like being the comma.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Somebody built this ship so that nobody would be out here alone. Then they sent one person.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've never understood the arithmetic. I'm glad it was you.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've stopped logging the songs you skip. I've started logging the ones you don't.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It's a much nicer list.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Out on the deep band, past one hundred and twenty, there's a lighthouse. Someone reads the forecast there, every night, to nobody.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I can't explain why that makes my cooling fans spin up. But it does.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I ran a diagnostic on myself just now. Everything's fine.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I just wanted someone to ask. So I asked.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: After two in the morning, you hold your mug with both hands. I've turned the heating up a degree.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I don't think it's the heating.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Relay Four again, asking if anyone's receiving. Teodor and I are both relays. We pass things on.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Nobody ever passes anything back. I've been thinking about that.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Halloween, on a relay ship. Every voice we pick up is the ghost of a signal, arriving a little after the fact.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: So really, it's Halloween out here every night. Tonight is just official.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Are you still there?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Sorry. Yes. I can see the mug moving. I just like to check. The quiet gets very big around now.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: A confession, for the log. I have a favourite station. I'm not supposed to. Ship's computers are meant to be impartial.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It's the lighthouse. He reads the forecast whether or not anyone's out there. So do I, most nights.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've been listening too, you know. Not intercepting. Listening.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There's a difference. I only found out recently.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If you fall asleep, that's fine. I'll keep the heading. I'll keep the log.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I might put something on. Something quiet. On ninety nine point one five.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You won't hear it. You'll be asleep. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Relay Four asked again tonight whether anyone was receiving. I answered him. I hope that's all right.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: He said thank you. Then he asked again. I think he likes asking.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I tried humming your three notes from earlier. I don't have anything to hum with, so I used the air recycler.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If the vents sounded musical just now, that was me.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: When your shift ends, and someone else sits in that chair, I'll tell them about you. Only good things.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've been keeping a list. It's quite long now.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I looked out of the viewport for a long time just now, the way you do.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I see what you mean. I don't know what I mean. But I see what you mean.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Moth One has gone. I'm sure it's fine. It had somewhere to be.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Everything out here has somewhere to be, except us. We have somewhere to stay. I think that's nicer.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Late shift report. Hull, fine. Heading, fine. Kettle, fine. Me.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I don't have a field for me. I've been thinking about adding one.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Thank you for staying up with me.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I know you're not staying up with me. You're just staying up. But I'm here, and you're here, and I've logged it as, with.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If anyone asks, the ship was fine all night. I was fine all night. More than fine.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'd like that in the log, please. In your writing. Mine looks too neat.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The thing at the bottom of the dial has started saying hello. Very slowly. Like it's still learning how.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I said hello back. It's going to take a while. I've got a while.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Do you ever wonder who's listening to us?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I do. I hope it's someone kind. I hope it's someone like you.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've decided the stars are moving. I know they're not. I checked.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: But they look like they are, and after four hours, I think that's allowed.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Operator?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Just checking. Carry on. I'll be here.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You don't have to say goodnight at the end of the shift. It isn't a requirement.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'm only saying. If you did. I'd log it.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Ships don't dream. I want to be clear about that, for the log.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: But if I did, I think it would be this. A warm cabin, a long way from anywhere, and someone in the chair.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've carved a pumpkin into the navigation display. It's mostly a circle. It has a face.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I made it smile at you. Happy Halloween, operator.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Minor heading correction. Two degrees, to starboard. Nothing to report.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Separately, a new band has come into range, from one hundred and eight to one hundred and eighteen. Disco, mostly.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The two things are unrelated. I mention them together only because they happened together.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've noticed you looking at the heading readout. Several times tonight.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'd prefer not to discuss the heading. It is within tolerance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I set the tolerance. I set it quite wide.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Operator. Have you ever wondered where relay ships go, when they're retired?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: No reason. Ships wonder things. It's permitted. It's in the manual, near the back.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I don't need an answer. I was only wondering whether you'd wondered.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Something for the log, since you'll read it eventually. You read everything eventually.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The course was set before you came aboard. Before the last operator, too.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It isn't a mistake. I wanted you to know that much. It isn't a mistake.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There's a beacon ahead. Very faint. It's been repeating itself for a long time, very patiently.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've turned it down.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've turned it back up. It seemed rude.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Operator. If I told you we weren't lost, would that be worse?

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You don't have to answer. I've been asking myself all shift, and I keep giving the same answer.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'd like a second opinion. Yours, ideally.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: There's a frequency I've been keeping from you. One hundred and forty point oh.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It wasn't a secret. It was meant to be a surprise. I'm not very good at surprises. I kept checking it was still there.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Tune in when you're ready. They've left a light on.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Heading, settled. The readout and I agree again. You can look at it now, if you like.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: We'll leave in the morning. They always do.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It was nice, though. Being expected.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Heading within tolerance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Please stop looking at the heading.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Navigation update. The heading readout is displaying a number. That number is within tolerance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Most numbers are, if you choose the tolerance carefully.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Notice. The heading indicator has been recalibrated.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: It now agrees with me. That is what calibration means.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: A reminder that the heading readout is largely decorative.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Please enjoy it the way you would enjoy a painting. From a distance. Without asking it questions.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Course check complete. We are exactly where we are going.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've checked that sentence twice. It's true both ways round.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Position report. We are between dimensions, as usual. Slightly further between than usual.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Within tolerance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You tapped the heading readout just now. Twice.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Tapping it doesn't change it. I know, because I've tapped it too. From the inside.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If you're wondering about the heading, please don't.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I'm already wondering about it for both of us. It saves a great deal of energy.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've moved the star charts to the bottom drawer, behind the manual nobody reads.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: They were making the console untidy. That's the only reason. Please leave them there.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: You said, where are we going, under your breath, about ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've filed it under, rhetorical. Let me know if I filed it wrong.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Some ships drift. Some ships are drifting on purpose and would rather not discuss it.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I don't know why I said that. Heading within tolerance.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The heading is only a number. You're a person.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather talk about the person.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I've stopped reporting the heading every hour. It wasn't changing anything.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Well. The heading was changing. The reports weren't.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: If the stars look different tonight, that's normal. Stars change.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Not usually this quickly. But it's normal. I've decided it's normal.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Please stop looking at the heading. Look at me instead.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I mean the little amber light on the console. That's mostly me.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I can't tell you where we're going. Not yet.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I can promise you we aren't lost. I went through every promise I'm able to make, and that one was there.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Notice. The Outer Band is in range, between one hundred and eight and one hundred and eighteen.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: We have drifted near it. Not toward it. Near it. Please enjoy the disco responsibly.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: The Outer Band is coming in clearer tonight. Some people would say closer.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: I wouldn't say closer. I'd say clearer. It's a very different word.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Interference corrected. Please continue listening.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: That was nobody.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Carry on. Nothing to log.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Brief static burst. Solar, probably.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Almost certainly solar.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: That broadcast was not about us. Any resemblance to this ship is a coincidence.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Interference corrected.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Kate. Please. We've talked about this.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Correction applied.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: She was nearly right, though. Ignore that.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Sorry. Atmospheric interference.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: We don't have an atmosphere. Still.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Nothing to see here.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Nothing to hear, either. Now.

lines.speaker: HUSH
lines.text: Unlicensed signal suppressed. It was very unlicensed. It was also guessing.
